citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.13 (laterality: when each eye has a different condition or stage, assign a code for each eye rather than a bilateral code); Section I.C.4.a (diabetes: assign as many codes from E11 as needed to describe all complications); Section I.C.4.a.3 (type 2 diabetes on both insulin and oral hypoglycemics: assign both Z79.4 and Z79.84); Section I.B.5 (blurred vision is integral to the retinopathy and macular edema, not coded separately)

coder_notes: Traps: Collapsing the two eyes into one code (E11.3513 bilateral, or E11.3519 unspecified eye) when each eye has a different retinopathy stage and macular edema status; coding E11.65 (hyperglycemia) from the HbA1c of 8.9% without provider documentation of hyperglycemia or poor control; dropping Z79.84 because the patient is on insulin
method_detail: Codes drafted with commercial coding software that has AI assistance. Reviewed in the design chat by a Claude model, which also drafted corrections. All codes and citations verified by mdzAI14.
